name: Seiga Kaku uses her amazing Taoist arts and gives you a life lesson
source:
Let the wicked hermit Seiga Kaku share her Taoist wisdom with you. With her help, you will surely achieve your goals in life and become a better person. To the Tao, no problem is insurmountable. Learn about the philosophy of Taoism, and how to apply it to find love, success, and peace of mind. And don't die.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1459710/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
让邪恶隐士加来清我与你分享她的道家智慧。在她的帮助下，你一定会实现人生目标并成为一个更好的人。对于道来说，没有什么问题是解决不了的。了解道教哲学，以及如何运用它来寻找爱情、成功和心灵的平静。并且不要死。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1459710/]Steam[/url]]
